details.description: Details about the exception. Usually contains the exception id for reference.

amount.description: Either amount or amount_in_paise is mandatory

amount_in_paise.description: Either amount or amount_in_paise is mandatory

corporate_account_number.description:
Corporate account number where debited amount from customer’s account is to be settled. Any one of corporate_account_number or settlement_config_profile_id or split_settlement_info is required. For Non Digio PA users, this is a mandatory attribute.

All numeric
Min len = 8 Max len = 18

corporate_config_id.description:
Optional. Passing the attribute is not required if the mandate already exists in the digio system, else error will be thrown.

Corporate config created from dashboard has below info and is auto populated during user authentication.
Utility Code
Service provider name
Sponsor bank name
Sponsor bank
Sponsor bank ifsc

Length = 32

customer_account_number.description: Optional, only applicable if mandate is not provided by Digio. Bank account number of customer

customer_name.description: Optional, only applicable if mandate is not provided by Digio. Name of the customer

destination_account_type.description:
Optional, only applicable if mandate is not provided by Digio. Default: SAVINGS

Pass one from below
SAVINGS,
CURRENT,
CC,
SB_NRE,
SB_NRO,
OTHER

destination_bank_id.description: Optional, only applicable if mandate is not provided by Digio. Valid IFSC or MICR Code

narration.description:
Default: Corporate name
Allowed chars: a-zA-Z.0-9
The value provided in narration, will be reflected in the customer account statement.

payment_count.description:
Refers to the number of consecutive debits to be undertaken
Note: payment_count has to be one if frequency is ONETIME

settlement_config_profile_id.description: For Digio PA users, easy to use config for custom settlement amount. Any one of corporate_account_number or settlement_config_profile_id or split_settlement_info is required.

settlement_date.description:
Date for Settlement in yyyy-mm-dd

Default:
(i) first_collection_date as provided in registered mandate
OR
(ii) current date

split_settlement_info.description: Only for Digio PA users, easy to use config for custom settlement amount. Any one of corporate_account_number or settlement_config_profile_id or split_settlement_info is required.

sub_user_identifier.description: Set value to assign it to a sub-user.  Provide the email_id of registered sub_user. If it is provided then the debit details will be available in sub user login

umrn.description: Mandate UMRN created upon successful registration of Mandate

unique_key.description:
To be used for Corporate’s reference should be unique for each debit request.

ex: umrn_1, umrn_2

Allowed chars: a-zA-Z.0-9_

Min len = 1 Max len = 30
Note : Please provide unique_key in the API call to avoid duplicate schedule/debit creation

NDTxnOptionalAttr_Client.description: Please refer below for the additional attributes, that should only be passed by Mutual Fund use case customers

additional_date.description:
Pass this attribute as blank. This will be populated by Sponsor Bank.
Date in DD-MM-YYYY format
In case of Lump Sum and SIP First Order, the date reported can be repeated. In case of running SIP Date of trigger of SIP will be reported

bank_code.description:
For YES Bank as sponsor bank, Pass RCY.
Will be provided by BSE/ICCL to the PA/Bank and it will be common for transactions uploaded by the specific PA/Bank.
ALPHA, No Special char

client_id.description:
UCC for the said Client.
ALPHA NUM, No Special char,

credit_utility_code.description:
UTILITY CODE of Clearing House / AMC where Funds will be Credited
ALPHA NUM, No Special char.
For ICCL, please pass: YESB00709000028661

destination_bank_code.description: Pass this attribute as blank. This will be populated by Sponsor Bank

member_id.description:
Member ID for whom the PA/ Bank is uploading the file
NUM, No Special char,

mis_shared_with.description:
ICCL: BSE Clearing
NSCCL: NSE Clearing
AMC: AMC

order_id.description:
Pass the Order Number for this SIP order
Will be sent by Member to PA/Bank to ICCL.
ALPHA NUM, No Special char

pg_bank_ref_number.description: Unique reference number provided by the member for payment to be collected for a unique client. Please pass the SIP Registration Number here, which will be sent to ICCLALPHA NUM, No Special char,

product_type.description:
MUT : Mutual Funds (will create file as per new SEBI and Exchanges guidelines)
For Non MF use cases, please DO NOT pass optional_attr and its associated attributes

utr_number.description:
Pass this attribute as blank. This will be populated by Sponsor Bank
Unique number generated for funds transferred in ICCL's Account

SplitSettlementInfo_Client.description: Any one of corporate_account_number or settlement_config_profile_id or split_settlement_info is required.

split_amount_in_paise.description: Amount to be settled in paise
